title: Care Management Tier Entry Criteria and Placement Precedence
content:
Prairie Ridge Health Plan runs Care Management in seven tiers. Each tier admits members on its own clinical and predictive criteria, and each carries a placement precedence number: when a member fits more than one tier, the lower precedence number wins.

## Schedule of entry criteria

| Care Management tier | Lowest predictive risk score | Highest predictive risk score | Fewest chronic conditions on claims, last 12 months | Pregnancy or postpartum status required | Qualifying Health Home conditions | Nursing facility level-of-care determination required | Placement precedence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | 0.00 | 1.49 | 0 | No | None | No | 7 |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 1.50 | 2.99 | 1 | No | None | No | 6 |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | 3.00 | 4.99 | 2 | No | None | No | 5 |
| Maternal Care Management | 0.00 | 99.99 | 0 | Yes | None | No | 3 |
| Complex Case Management | 5.00 | 99.99 | 3 | No | None | No | 4 |
| Health Home Services | 0.00 | 99.99 | 2 | No | Serious mental illness; substance use disorder; two chronic conditions | No | 2 |
| LTSS Service Coordination | 0.00 | 99.99 | 0 | No | None | Yes | 1 |

## Reading the columns

- **Risk score limits** are predictive risk scores to two decimal places, and both limits are admitted to the tier. A highest score of 99.99 means the tier has no upper bound on the risk score.
- **Chronic conditions** counts the chronic conditions on the member's claims in the last 12 months; the figure is the fewest the tier admits.
- **Pregnancy or postpartum status**: Maternal Care Management is the only tier that requires the member to be pregnant or within the postpartum year.
- **Qualifying Health Home conditions** lists the conditions that qualify for Health Home Services; the list is empty for every other tier.
- **Nursing facility level of care**: LTSS Service Coordination is the only tier that requires a nursing facility level-of-care determination.
- **Placement precedence**: 1 is the strongest claim on the member and 7 the weakest.

## Band edges (hypothetical scores)

The risk score bands of the three banded tiers below Complex Case Management meet without a gap at two decimal places:

| Hypothetical risk score | Band it falls in |
|---|---|
| 1.49 | Healthy Living Support (0.00 to 1.49) |
| 1.50 | Care Coordination Level 1 (1.50 to 2.99) |
| 2.99 | Care Coordination Level 1 |
| 3.00 | Care Coordination Level 2 (3.00 to 4.99) |
| 4.99 | Care Coordination Level 2 |
| 5.00 | Complex Case Management (5.00 and above) |

A score alone does not settle the tier: Care Coordination Level 1 also asks for at least 1 chronic condition, Level 2 for at least 2 and Complex Case Management for at least 3.

## Precedence in order

Ranked from the lowest precedence number: LTSS Service Coordination (1), Health Home Services (2), Maternal Care Management (3), Complex Case Management (4), Care Coordination Level 2 (5), Care Coordination Level 1 (6), Healthy Living Support (7). For example, a hypothetical member who has a nursing facility level-of-care determination and is also pregnant fits both LTSS Service Coordination and Maternal Care Management, and is placed in LTSS Service Coordination because 1 is lower than 3.
